rules.description: Applicant must have an existing driving licence
rules.reason_if_failed: You need an existing driving licence to update the address. Apply for a new licence instead.

rules.description: Applicant must be a resident of Great Britain
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for Great Britain residents only. There's a different process in Northern Ireland.

rules.description: Applicant must not be banned from driving
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot update your address while banned from driving. Contact DVLA for assistance.

rules.description: New address must be different from current address
rules.reason_if_failed: The new address you provided is the same as your current address on record.

rules.description: Applicant must provide addresses for the last 3 years
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide all addresses you've lived at in the last 3 years.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is moving to an address outside Great Britain
edge_cases.action: Cannot register foreign address on British driving licence. Route to handoff. Contact driving licence authority in new country of residence.

edge_cases.description: Applicant wants to change photo at the same time and licence valid 2+ years
edge_cases.action: Redirect to licence renewal service with £14 fee. This is a renewal, not just an address update.

edge_cases.description: Applicant wants to change name at the same time
edge_cases.action: Route to postal application. Name changes cannot be done online.

edge_cases.description: Address change is overdue (more than 3 months since moving)
edge_cases.action: Warn that this is a legal requirement and delay may result in a fine up to £1,000. Proceed with update but flag for potential enforcement review.
